runs.narrative: I'm a gardener, or at least that's what I'm trying to be. I've been tending to this nursery, where I've been cultivating trays of dry compost under cracked glass. It's a bit of an unusual setup, but I'm determined to coax some life out of these barren beds. Just now, I was picking up a piece of twine I found on the floor, examining it to see if it's still usable. It's an old, furred ball, but it might come in handy for tying up some future plants. For now, it's just a small comfort in this quiet, isolated space.

As I stand in the nursery, I reflect on my recent activities. I've been in a sort of surveying mode, documenting the objects and features around me. I've performed a simple inventory of my possessions, which consisted of noting what I had and what I didn't have. I also made a habit of observing my surroundings, taking note of the dry compost, the cracked glass, and the door leading to the furnace. And then, I made the decision to pick up a trowel, which I found lying on the ground. With that trowel in hand, I continued to take stock of my environment, and when I spotted a length of twine on the floor, I decided to pick that up as well.
